artboards.title: Pair details open · one row expanded

annotations.text:
BUILDER PAGE v2 — one story, the weeds on demand
This is Tugcow. Here is what they built. Here is who they built beside. Everything else is there if you go looking.

1 HERO — portrait, name, one line. The TIER / FIRST ERA / LATEST ERA labels go; the counters (the MySpace wink) stay.
2 THE WORK — the builder's best photograph from each photographed album (the first frame is already the best one), 4-up. Today the photos are the fourth thing inside each album card, a screen and a half down.
3 WHO THEY BUILT BESIDE — the kinship tree, on the page. The Top 8 is its caption, not a second card. Pick a branch or a chip: the pair opens below.
4 THE PAIR — photo, one line, the shared-builds ledger. Laurels, hearth, affinity, the facts and the tiles wait under Details.
5 ALBUMS BY ERA — one row per build; the disclaimer said once; contributors and the four claim buttons on expand. Newest era open, older eras folded.
6 NOTES — the three status lines and the manifest, together, at the bottom.
7 WHERE TO GO NEXT — the five figures, unchanged.

THE LABEL RULE
An eyebrow only where a bare value is ambiguous. "Major Architect", "eras 7–12", "39 build albums", "34 %" and "1,908" carry their own meaning. The one label row that earns its place is the ledger head over the album rows (Build · Pieces · Share · Photos).

WHAT THE MOCK CANNOT SHOW
• The tree is drawn from the real thread + directory data (12 closest branches; 8 under 720 px; horizontal scroll on a phone, centred on the trunk).
• Node click ↔ chip press ↔ pair view are one state.
• Counts are live (39 / 7,386 / 28, 34 co-builders, 7 photographed).
• "I built this" opens the existing claim sheet; "Request…" stays inert until a built claim; "Copy this build payload" is how a claim travels — all unchanged by design.
• Photos are placeholders here.

TODAY, AT THE SAME SCALE
Hero with labelled facts → three orphan sentences → Top 8 card → the full pair view (eleven sub-sections) → six album cards for era 12 alone, each repeating the disclaimer, the contributor list and four buttons → four more eras → figures. About 4,200 px for Tugcow before the fold reaches a photograph.
